info.title: kanbot API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`. Besides the responses listed for it, any operation may answer `429` (rate limited; `Retry-After` says when to retry), `500` (a server failure) or `503` (the database or identity provider is unavailable, or the server is overloaded; temporary).

get.summary: The audit log, newest first. Platform admins only.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Only entries older than this entry ID (the previous page's
`next_before`).

200.description: A page of the audit log.

403.description: Not allowed to read the audit log.

get.summary:
Where the identity provider sends the browser back. Finishes the
sign-in and redirects to the app: the web app with its session cookie
(to `/`, or `/login?error=...`), a native app with a one-time code
(`<redirect_uri>?code=...`, or `?error=...`). The `error` is
`access_denied`, `login_failed` or `no_role`, never more.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state sent with the authorization request.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The identity provider's error, instead of a code.

303.description: To the app, with the outcome.

get.summary:
What an app needs before signing in: where to sign in, whether
telemetry can be sent, and the server version. Public.
Starts a sign-in: redirects the browser to the identity provider.
get.description:
The web app navigates here; native apps open it in the system browser
with their redirect URI and PKCE challenge.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description:
Native only: `dev.sideral.kanbot:/auth/done`, or
`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/auth/done` on Windows and Linux.

parameters.name: code_challenge
parameters.description: Native only: the S256 PKCE challenge of the app's verifier.

303.description: To the identity provider's sign-in page.

422.description: Parameters that do not fit the platform, or a redirect URI that is not the app's.

503.description: The identity provider has not been discovered yet.

post.summary:
Signs out: ends the current kanbot session (and clears the web
app's cookie). Needs a session; an identity provider's access token
has none.

400.description: The request was not made with a kanbot session.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role or is disabled.

post.summary: Redeems a native app's one-time code for its session token.
post.description:
The code is single use and expires after 60 seconds; the verifier must
match the challenge the app sent to `/auth/login`.

400.description: The code is invalid, used or expired, or the verifier is wrong.

422.description: The verifier is not a valid PKCE verifier.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and serving HTTP.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

200.description: The user, with the new preferences.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

422.description: The body is not valid preferences.

get.summary: The organizations the caller may read, by slug.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

post.summary: Creates an organization. Platform admins only.

403.description: Not allowed to create organizations.

422.description: The slug or name is invalid.

get.summary: An organization, and what the caller may do to it.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

delete.summary:
Deletes an organization, its admins and its team links. Platform
admins only; the Default organization cannot be deleted.

403.description: Not allowed to delete the organization.

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

409.description: The Default organization cannot be deleted.

patch.summary: Renames an organization or changes its slug.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the organization.

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

422.description: The slug or name is invalid.

get.summary: The organization's admins, a page at a time, by display name.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

put.summary: Makes a user an admin of the organization.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the organization's admins.

404.description: No such organization or user, or not allowed to read the organization.

delete.summary: Removes a user from the organization's admins.

204.description: The user is no longer an admin.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the organization's admins.

404.description: No such organization, the user is not an admin, or not allowed to read the organization.

put.summary:
Links the organization to an `OpenShell` workspace; kanbot then keeps the
workspace's members in sync: the organization's admins as admins, the
members of its teams with write access as users. Platform admins only.

403.description: Not allowed to link the organization, or `OpenShell` refused the user.

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

409.description: The server has no `OpenShell` integration, or another organization links the workspace.

422.description: No such workspace (`/workspace`: `not_found`), or an invalid name.

503.description: `OpenShell` or the identity provider cannot be reached.

delete.summary:
Unlinks the organization from its `OpenShell` workspace; kanbot then
removes the members it added there. Platform admins only.

403.description: Not allowed to unlink the organization.

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

get.summary: The teams linked to the organization, a page at a time, by slug.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Linked teams per page: 1 to 500, default 100.

200.description: A page of the linked teams.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

404.description: No such organization, or not allowed to read it.

put.summary: Links a team to the organization, or changes its access.

204.description: The team is linked with this access.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the organization's team links.

404.description: No such organization or team, or not allowed to read the organization.

422.description: The body is not a team link.

delete.summary: Unlinks a team from the organization.

204.description: The team is no longer linked.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the organization's team links.

404.description: No such organization, the team is not linked, or not allowed to read the organization.

get.summary:
Readiness: the database is reachable, every migration has been applied,
and the identity provider's signing keys have been loaded. Until
`kanbot-backend migrate` has run, the old schema is in place and
requests could fail; until the keys load, no request can be
authenticated. Either way the instance takes no traffic.

503.description: Not ready: the database is unreachable, migrations are pending, or the identity provider's keys have not loaded.

get.summary:
The teams the caller may see, by slug: their own, or all of them for
platform and organization admins.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

post.summary:
Creates a team, with the caller as its maintainer. Platform admins and
organization admins only.

403.description: Not allowed to create teams.

422.description: The slug or name is invalid.

get.summary: A team, and what the caller may do to it.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

404.description: No such team, or not allowed to see it.

delete.summary: Deletes a team, its memberships and its links.

403.description: Not allowed to delete the team.

404.description: No such team, or not allowed to see it.

patch.summary:
Renames a team, changes its slug, or sets or clears its identity
provider group (platform admins only).

403.description: Not allowed to make this change.

404.description: No such team, or not allowed to see it.

409.description: The slug or the identity provider group is taken.

delete.summary:
Stops syncing the team with its identity provider group: the synced
members are removed and the team is managed by hand again. Platform
admins only. The same as `PATCH` with `"idp_group": null`, for clients
that cannot send a null.

403.description: Not allowed to change the team's identity provider group.

404.description: No such team, or not allowed to see it.

get.summary:
The team's members, a page at a time: maintainers first, then by
display name.

403.description: The user has no kanbot role (`forbidden`) or is disabled (`account_disabled`).

404.description: No such team, or not allowed to see it.

put.summary: Adds a user to the team with a role, or changes their role.

204.description: The user is a member with this role.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the team's members.

404.description: No such team or user, or not allowed to see the team.

409.description: The membership comes from the identity provider.

422.description: The body is not a member change.

delete.summary: Removes a user from the team.

204.description: The user is no longer a member.

403.description: Not allowed to manage the team's members.

404.description: No such team, the user is not a member, or not allowed to see the team.

409.description: The membership comes from the identity provider.

get.summary:
Users who have signed in, by display name (at most 20), to add as
organization admins or team members. Disabled users are left out.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Part of the display name, any case, at most 100 characters. Empty
or absent: the first users by name.

403.description: Only platform admins, organization admins and team maintainers may search users.

422.description: `query` is longer than 100 characters (`too_long`) or holds a control character (`invalid`).

AccessDto.description:
What a linked team's members may do in the organization. `write`
includes `read`.

AuditEntryDto.description: One change to an organization or a team.

action.description:
What happened, as `<target type>.<event>`, for example
`organization.team_linked`.

details.description: IDs and enumerated values describing the change.

policy_ids.description: The policies that allowed the change.

AuditPage.description: A page of the audit log, newest first.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last one.

AuthConfig.description: What an app needs to know before signing in.

login_url.description: Where to start a sign-in (`?platform=web` or `?platform=native&...`).

telemetry_available.description:
Whether this instance relays the app's telemetry. Each user still
decides (`telemetry_opt_in`).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error codes. Clients depend on these strings:
add new codes, but never rename or reuse one.

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request.

code.description:
Why it is invalid, as a stable `snake_case` code (`too_long`,
`required`, ...). Never the invalid value itself.

pointer.description:
JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field in the request body, for example
`/title` or `/labels/2`.

LinkedTeamDto.description:
A team linked to an organization, as the organization's readers see
it: not its identity provider group, which only those who may see the
team learn (`GET /teams/{id}`).

logout_url.description:
For a web session, where to send the browser to sign out of the
identity provider too, when it supports that (RP-initiated logout).
`null` otherwise, and always for a native session: native apps sign
out without opening a browser.

permissions.description: What the user may do across the instance.

telemetry_opt_in.description: Whether the app may send telemetry. Off until the user opts in.

MemberChangeDto.description: The role to give a member.

MemberPageDto.description: A page of a team's members.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

MembershipSourceDto.description: How a member got into the team.

slug.description:
1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or
ending with a hyphen. Unique.

NewTeamDto.description: A new team. Its creator becomes its maintainer.

slug.description:
1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or
ending with a hyphen. Unique.

OpenShellLinkDto.description: The `OpenShell` workspace to link an organization to.

workspace.description:
The workspace's name in `OpenShell`. It must exist, and the user
linking it must be able to see it there.

OrganizationAdminPageDto.description: A page of an organization's admins.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

OrganizationChangesDto.description: The fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

OrganizationDto.description: An organization, and what the caller may do to it.

openshell_workspace.description:
The `OpenShell` workspace whose membership kanbot syncs with this
organization, if linked.

OrganizationPageDto.description: A page of the organizations the caller may read.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

OrganizationPermissionDto.description:
Something the caller may do to an organization besides reading it.
The app shows only the controls the user can use; the server checks
every request anyway.

PlatformPermissionDto.description:
Something the user may do across the instance. The app shows only the
controls the user can use; the server checks every request anyway.

PlatformRoleDto.description: What the user may do across the whole instance.

telemetry_opt_in.description: Allow the app to send telemetry.

Problem.description:
A problem details body (RFC 9457), with the `code` and `errors`
extension members.

errors.description: The invalid fields of a `validation_failed` problem.

status.description: Always the status of the response that carries the problem.

trace_id.description:
The W3C trace id of the request (32 hex digits), when telemetry is
on. Lets support find the request's trace and logs.

TeamChangesDto.description: The fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

idp_group.description:
An identity provider group to sync the members with, or `null` to
stop syncing. Platform admins only. Setting a group removes the
current members; the group's members join as they sign in.
Clearing it removes the synced members.

TeamDto.description: A team, and what the caller may do to it.

idp_group.description:
Set: the members are the users whose groups claim contains this
identity provider group, and they cannot be edited.

TeamLinkChangeDto.description: The access to give a linked team.

TeamLinkDto.description: A team linked to an organization.

TeamLinkPageDto.description: A page of the teams linked to an organization.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

TeamPageDto.description: A page of the teams the caller may see.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

TeamPermissionDto.description:
Something the caller may do to a team besides seeing it. The app shows
only the controls the user can use; the server checks every request
anyway.

idp_group.description:
Set: the members are the users whose groups claim contains this
identity provider group, and they cannot be edited.

TokenRequest.description: `POST /auth/token`: a native app redeems its one-time code.

code.description: The `code` the app received at its redirect URI.

code_verifier.description:
The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge the app sent to `/auth/login`
(RFC 7636: 43 to 128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~`).

expires_at.description:
When the session ends at the latest (RFC 3339, UTC). It can end
sooner: when idle, on logout, or when the identity provider refuses
to refresh it.

session_token.description:
Send as `Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`. Store it only in
the platform's secure storage.

UserSummaryDto.description: A user, as other users see them.

disabled.description:
Disabled in kanbot: they cannot sign in, and cannot be added
anywhere; remove them where they are listed.

bearer.description: An access token (JWT) from the deployment's OIDC identity provider, or a native app's kanbot session token (`kbs_...`).

session.name: __Host-kanbot_session
session.description: The web app's session (HttpOnly). State-changing requests also need `Origin` equal to the server's and `X-Kanbot-CSRF: 1`.
